content_data.meeting_title: Regional Healthcare Security Pilot - Phase 1 Review & Next Steps
agenda_items: Analysis of initial security incident metrics and mitigation strategies
Identification of key risks and dependencies for the next period
Assessment of compliance readiness for upcoming regulatory changes
Planning for Phase 2 scope and resource allocation
Review of Phase 1 pilot implementation status
Discussion on user adoption and training feedback
key_decisions: Greenlit procurement of advanced threat detection software for evaluation in Phase 2.
Prioritized development of a centralized security incident response playbook for regional facilities.
Approved enhanced multi-factor authentication protocol rollout to all pilot users by end of current month.
Established a dedicated working group to address data privacy implications of new security measures.
attendees: Mr. David Kim, Lead Consultant (Consulting Firm)
